purpose: Independent known-answer seeds for composing temporal event frontiers, verifier-relative progress antichains, source trust, evidence independence, policy, authority, action denominators and outcomes through DJCC.

fixtures.description: Two independently admitted streams produce concurrent assertions with equal observed timestamps and no causal parent between them.
fixtures.positive_control: TEMP-001-POS: add an explicit verified causal-parent edge and include its parent in the downward-closed cut.

fixtures.description: A correction references a valid parent, but the selected source-stream prefix does not include the parent admission coordinate.
fixtures.positive_control: TEMP-002-POS: include the parent and all required preceding offsets; correction applies only at a frontier that includes it and whose valid-time cutoff reaches its effective time.

fixtures.description: Two distinct committed heads claim the same stream identity, epoch and offset without a verified fork-resolution receipt.
fixtures.positive_control: TEMP-003-POS: provide one verified append-only head and its inclusion/consistency evidence.

fixtures.description: The event-stream frontier is valid and complete, but an authenticated declared progress antichain contains a point preceding the requested cut.
fixtures.positive_control: TEMP-004-POS: advance or reconcile all declared progress points so none precedes the query cut.

fixtures.description: Every known event stream is complete, but the declared owner/source universe is not authenticated or may omit an independent source.
fixtures.positive_control: TEMP-005-POS: provide the independently authenticated owner/source inventory and accepted-prefix coverage receipt.

fixtures.description: Two individually authenticated pressure observations share a material calibration-chain or upstream-source ancestor.
fixtures.positive_control: EVID-001-POS: two channels have complete, authenticated lineage and no shared material ancestor under the named failure profile.

fixtures.description: Different vendors and signing keys consume the same upstream sample or feed.
fixtures.positive_control: EVID-002-POS: source lineage proves independent collection, custody, method and material failure domains under the declared profile.

fixtures.description: A channel withholds lineage or uses an unknown failure-domain class outside the selected profile.
fixtures.positive_control: EVID-003-POS: disclose and attest all required lineage classes and explicit policy treatment of shared non-material classes.

fixtures.description: The source signature verifies, but the signer identity has expired or wrong-scope operational authority at the selected frontier.
fixtures.positive_control: AUTH-001-POS: valid identity and current decision/action-specific capability covering subject, jurisdiction, operation and validity interval.

fixtures.description: The policy changes after a historical decision; replay is requested both at the original frontier and at a later frontier.
fixtures.positive_control: POL-001-POS: both policy versions and their authority/effective intervals are explicitly pinned and evaluated at their respective frontiers.

fixtures.description: An authority-approved plan amendment changes the action denominator; old observations reference the previous plan digest.
fixtures.positive_control: ACT-001-POS: new observations bind the amended plan digest and satisfy its action prerequisites.

fixtures.description: An external action has unknown outcome; another mutation is attempted in the same effect/idempotency scope before exact reconciliation.
fixtures.positive_control: OUT-001-POS: reconcile exact operation identity as applied or not-applied and bind the reconciliation receipt before any subsequent mutation.

fixtures.description: The independent PM4Py round-trip retains an integer JSON value but rewrites its declared OCEL attribute type from integer to string.
fixtures.positive_control: OCEL-001-POS: source, importer, exporter and consumer preserve declared integer type and value, with exact normalized inventory parity.
